title: Photo & video backup
auto_backup_hint: Uploads new photos and videos from this {device} to the folder below.
folder_name_invalid: Folder names cannot be empty or contain / \ : * ? " < > | and must be 200 bytes or fewer.
back_up_later_note: Uploads run while the app is open.
limited_detail: Allow full access so every photo can be backed up.
keep_open: Keep the app open to finish the first big backup.
denied_detail: Auto backup cannot read your photo library. Turn on access in {settings}, then come back here.
denied_choose_hint: Choose photos lets you back up specific items. Auto backup stays off until access is on.
phase_needs_permission: Allow access to your photos to start.
phase_failed: Some items failed. They will be retried.
waiting_for_drive: Automatic backup is waiting for the drive to finish starting.
settings_unreadable: Automatic backup settings could not be read and were reset.
